KaTeX 0.18.7
https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX

Vendored from the official release asset
https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/download/v0.18.7/katex.tar.gz
(SHA-256 ea488c6a60ca97b9c92c010e7cd400f13f39fb262d8d506bd85bba3e528a7b53), whose
katex.min.js, katex.min.css and woff2 fonts are byte-identical to the npm package
katex@0.18.7 (registry integrity
sha512-h+UCwkZ+4Jz8WQ7MLGfj7UVFrRCizGb912fwF4luGdYsC5paYG1vx+jy+KRcC/XkpjGva/P7nAWuxNnPzRvzHw==).
katex.min.js and katex.min.css also match the cdnjs SRI hashes published for 0.18.7.

What is vendored, and what is not:
  - katex.min.js verbatim (the UMD build; it defines `window.katex`).
  - katex.min.css with every @font-face reduced to its woff2 source: the `,url(….woff)
    format("woff")` and `,url(….ttf) format("truetype")` entries are removed, the woff2
    url is unchanged, and nothing else in the file is touched. The urls stay relative, so
    they resolve against this folder and are served by PreviewSchemeHandler.
  - the woff2 fonts only (no woff, no ttf).
  - No contrib extension: no auto-render, no mhchem, no copy-tex, no
    mathtex-script-type, no render-a11y-string.
